treeView.pageDesc: QTreeView usage patterns sourced from DMS3 and XSign_frontend. The canonical way to manage state is useTreeCtx(namespace) + proxyRefs in setup(), not $refs. Always call resetTreeCtx(namespace) in beforeUnmount.

basic.title: Basic Selection
basic.desc: No drag, no menu, no count. Call resetGroupOpenIds(allGroup, selectedId) after init to auto-expand to the selected node.

menu.title: Dynamic Context Menu
menu.desc: menu-icon-click pattern: build the menu dynamically per node just before the dropdown opens.

checkbox.title: Checkbox Multi-select
checkbox.desc: Dialog mode: confirm/cancel to select multiple nodes.

drag.title: Drag & Drop Reorder
drag.desc: Enable isDraggable to allow reordering siblings or moving nodes across hierarchy levels.

apiRef.useTreeCtx: Returns a reactive context object bound to the matching :namespace on <q-tree-view>. Wrap with proxyRefs so methods are accessible without .value.
apiRef.resetTreeCtx: Destroy the context. Call in beforeUnmount to avoid memory leaks when the component is reused.
apiRef.setIsDraggable: Enable or disable drag-and-drop. Default: true.
apiRef.setIsShowMenu: Show or hide the 3-dot menu icon on hover.
apiRef.setIsShowCount: Show or hide the deviceCount badge.
apiRef.setIsDialog: Apply dialog-context row sizing (52px rows, no drag styling).
apiRef.setAllGroup: Required for drag. Flat map {'{'} [id]: {'{'} isSubGroupExist, parentId, depth, ... {'}'} {'}'}.
apiRef.setSelectedGroupId: Highlight a node as selected. Pass null to deselect.
apiRef.resetGroupOpenIds: Expand all ancestor nodes of the given id. Call after init to reveal the current selection.
apiRef.setTreeMenu: Set a per-node context menu [ {'{'} title, action {'}'} ] just before the dropdown opens. Call inside {'@'}menu-icon-click.
apiRef.setCheckedIds: Sync the checked node list into the tree. Used in checkbox mode.
apiRef.setIsHierarchyMoveAllowed: Allow dragging a node into another node (nesting). Default: false.
apiRef.dragAndMoveInfo: Object with {'{'} moveIds, moveTargetId, moveTargetType, dragTargetId {'}'}. Read after {'@'}group-move fires.
apiRef.resetDragAndMoveInfo: Reset drag state. Always call at the end of your {'@'}group-move handler.
apiRef.treeClick: Node row clicked (not the expand arrow).
apiRef.menuIconClick: The ··· icon was clicked. Set the menu here via ctx.setTreeMenu(id, items).
apiRef.updateGroupCheck: Checkbox toggled. Manage your own checkedIds array and sync via ctx.setCheckedIds(ids).
apiRef.groupMove: Drag dropped. Read ctx.dragAndMoveInfo, update your data, then call ctx.resetDragAndMoveInfo().

routerGuard.pageDesc: Two auth guard strategies observed across projects. Both use the createAppRouter factory — only the getAccessToken and onMissingToken options differ.

tokenGuard.title: Token Guard (JWT / localStorage)
tokenGuard.desc: Used in DMS3 and this starter. The token is written to localStorage after login (or extracted from URL params on first load). The guard reads it synchronously on every navigation.
steps: On app init, check URL for ?token= param and persist to localStorage.
beforeEach calls getAccessToken(). If null → redirect to TokenExpired page.
Token refresh is handled by the HTTP client interceptor, not the router.

sessionGuard.title: Session Guard (Server-side Session Cookie)
sessionGuard.desc: Used in XSign. The backend manages the session cookie. The frontend only tracks a signed flag in the Vuex store, populated after a successful login API call.
steps: After login API succeeds, store.commit sets loginStatus.signed = true.
If null → next() with no redirect (backend returns 401/redirect for expired sessions).
onMissingToken: null — the router does not redirect; backend handles auth.
